name: quarto-revealjs-live-questions
description: Live polls, quizzes, word clouds and rating scales for Quarto revealjs decks, with a Cloudflare or Docker backend
author: Sean Davis

scripts.build: bun run build:deck && bun run build:audience && bun run build:node
scripts.build:deck: bun build src/deck/plugin.ts --target=browser --format=iife --banner '/*! live-questions | MIT | https://github.com/seandavi/quarto-revealjs-live-questions | includes qrcode-generator, (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase, MIT: see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md */' --outfile=_extensions/live-questions/live-questions.js

PRESENTER_KEY.description: The presenter secret: whoever holds it can open and run your questions. Use a long random value, for example the output of `openssl rand -hex 24`, and keep a copy: you open your deck once with `?presenter=<key>`.

ROOMS.description: One SQLite-backed Durable Object per live session. Created for you; nothing to configure.
